senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. דּוּר)to go around, with מ־ or הימ־ to turn away, be estranged; to deviate.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 72b:7">Yoma 72ᵇ</cite> <he>זָרָה הימנו</he> the Law departs from him (is forgotten); v. <cite ref="G00659"><he>זָר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 5</cite> (play on <he>ז̇ר̇מ̇ת̇ם̇</he>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:8">ib.</cite>) <he>זָֹר̇וּ מ̇תו ות̇מ̇ו</he> they deviated (from the Law) &c.; <he>זרו מתורתיך וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 841">Yalk. Ps. 841</cite>.
